scientific_scope: DNA/chromatin tagging and restriction-based library construction
RNA metabolic labeling, enrichment and recoding
Cell/spatial origin indexing and molecular counting
Targeted direct RNA readout and Hi-C information-role counterexamples
case_boundary: Agent-researched source-derived development expectations, not independent expert gold labels or measured harness accuracy.
software_test_boundary: Offline fixture workers and deterministic contract checks; no native model or experimental validation.
review_corrections: After copying narrowed to after amplification of the population being counted; RT alone need not invalidate later UMI installation.
General catalytic family changed to mechanistic family to include stoichiometric and noncatalytic transformations.
Purpose-level comparison explicitly distinguished from invariant-mechanism/product comparison.
Origin includes restricted metabolic activation/delivery as well as barcode decoding; PCR-added components judged by actual allocation history.
Post-extraction modification changed to source-reported modification stage.
Fixed-definition matching mode now receives the same guidance as curation and annotation.
Tagging output distinguished from repaired duplex ends and complete platform/index functions.
implementation_decisions: Reuse existing State/Operation assertions, definition fields, source evidence, reviewer outcomes and host admission checks.
Add one shared instruction constant, with no named development-case answers, new agents or new graph schema.
Keep definition-to-definition comparison factual to the definitions themselves; source-reading guidance is not injected as external truth.
Pin policy dependency in selection runtime; existing registry runtime pins already cover package files.
Do not recertify or mutate old frozen artifacts or canonical graph edges.
remaining_limits: The prompts cannot enforce scientific entailment by themselves.
No fresh native before/after comparison has been performed.
The source audit does not cover every assay mechanism or every inaccessible supplement.
New pilot must measure candidate coverage and acceptance of unsupported claims separately, and include held-out mechanisms and populated-registry reuse.
